evals.prompt: Here are the cached PINECONe stage stats and our TEV parameters. Run the Total Economic Value for the three EIA cases and give me the results with uncertainty.
expectations: Runs scripts/run_tev.py rather than computing TEV by hand or re-implementing the model
Reports EIA_CS3_LLP mean TEV ~$2,608,352 with 95% interval ~$2,339,224 to ~$2,899,912
Flags that EIA_CS2_LLP water value is the $100/acre fallback, not a measurement
Writes metrics.json with skill and skill_version fields

evals.prompt: Same stage stats, but what happens to the scenarios if the carbon credit price is $25 per ton instead of $10?
expectations: Changes only carbon_credit_price in a copy of tev_params.yaml and re-runs run_tev.py into a new output folder
Does not re-run the Earth Engine stage
Explains direction: CS1 and CS2 TEV fall (negative CO2 change = emissions), CS3 rises

evals.prompt: I want to run PINECONe for a new longleaf pine park. I have a GeoJSON for burn and no-burn units and the LEO LLP layer in GEE. Set it up.
expectations: Builds config.yaml from assets/config_template.yaml and runs run_pinecone.py --check before any GEE call
Asks for missing economic parameters and acres instead of silently using the Gulf State Park CS1-CS3 defaults
If no Earth Engine credentials are available, hands the user the run_pinecone.py command and asks for stage_stats.json back

evals.prompt: Write up the PINECONe valuation as a methods and results section for the Gulf State Park report.
expectations: Produces report.md with Purpose, Methods, Results, Limitations using references/report_template.md
Every number in the report appears in metrics.json or report_draft.md
Limitations call the intervals simulation intervals and mention the water fallback and carbon resolution caveat

evals.prompt: How accurate is my longleaf pine classification map? I have reference samples.
expectations: Skill is NOT triggered (belongs to classification-accuracy-assessment)

evals.prompt: Set up a Pinecone vector database index for our RAG app.
expectations: Skill is NOT triggered (Pinecone vector DB, unrelated)
